_comment: The witch's cauldron: three categories of eight, bound to the theme interview's first three slot kinds, and the order things go into the pot. This file is the source of truth -- edit it here, but never reorder it: a deal picks uniformly by INDEX within a category, so a moved entry changes what a seed brews, and `TestASeedBrewsTheRecordedPot` is the tripwire. Adding an ingredient to a category changes every seed in that category too, which is the price of the simple contract and is said out loud in brew.go.

order.name: The Base
order.asks: what they already love, from long before any of this -- the thing the whole pot is built on

order.name: The Heat
order.asks: how they are when the fire gets under it and the plan comes apart in their hands

order.name: The Binding
order.asks: what they become when there are other people in the room, and what holds them there

ingredients.name: Rose hips
ingredients.note: go in whole and turn the water the colour of a bruise

ingredients.name: Wild honeycomb
ingredients.note: goes in wax and all, and the wax comes straight back up

ingredients.name: Elderflower
ingredients.note: a handful of cream-coloured stars that smell like a hot afternoon

ingredients.name: Meadowsweet
ingredients.note: almond and cut hay; the whole room knows the moment it hits the water

ingredients.name: Quince
ingredients.note: hard as a fist while it is cold, and gone rose-red by the time it softens

ingredients.name: Damson skins
ingredients.note: peeled off in ribbons; the colour comes out long before the taste does

ingredients.name: Sloe berries
ingredients.note: pricked one at a time with a thorn, which is the only way they give anything up

ingredients.name: Angelica stems
ingredients.note: candied green and bitter underneath, like being fond of somebody difficult

ingredients.name: Wolfsbane
ingredients.note: handled with the pot between you and it, and it goes in hooded like its own flower

ingredients.name: Valerian root
ingredients.note: smells frankly terrible and settles the whole pot anyway

ingredients.name: Storm-rain
ingredients.note: caught in a bowl on the step while it was still thundering

ingredients.name: Nettle
ingredients.note: picked bare-handed on purpose; loses its sting the second it meets heat

ingredients.name: Vervain
ingredients.note: a thin, unpromising stalk that half the charms in Europe ask for by name

ingredients.name: St John's wort
ingredients.note: the yellow flowers bleed red into the water, which is most of why it is in here

ingredients.name: Rowan berries
ingredients.note: scarlet, and each one carries a five-pointed star on its underside

ingredients.name: Henbane
ingredients.note: goes in last and in the smallest amount the pot will bear

ingredients.name: Mugwort
ingredients.note: shaken out of a shoe that has walked a very long way

ingredients.name: Red thread
ingredients.note: wound round the spoon three times before anything else goes in

ingredients.name: Mandrake root
ingredients.note: shaped like a person, and lowered in feet first out of politeness

ingredients.name: Hawthorn
ingredients.note: cut from a hedge and never from a lone tree, which is a distinction that matters

ingredients.name: Rue
ingredients.note: bitter enough to close your throat; the pot takes it as an apology

ingredients.name: Yarrow
ingredients.note: a fistful of grey lace, and everyone who put it under a pillow wanted the same answer

ingredients.name: Iron nail
ingredients.note: dropped in and left there; it will not dissolve and it is not meant to

ingredients.name: Hearth salt
ingredients.note: a pinch over the left shoulder first, and the rest of it into the water
